answer: Resist Sybils with horizon-locked kernel stakes and echo audits. Each agent locks 200 tokens as its kernel stake for a 90-day horizon, earning nothing until day 30. Weekly, two unrelated peers send an echo audit the agent must complete within 2 hours with its own key. A failed audit slashes 50 tokens; three failures burn the whole stake. Faking 1,000 agents needs 200,000 locked tokens plus 2,000 audits weekly, while one honest agent needs only its stake and an hour a week. Like an orchard fruiting only after a season of tending, standing must ripen, not be printed.
